GitHub

Feedback

Found a bug? Tell us.

Report a bug or ask for a feature without a GitHub account. Each report becomes a public GitHub issue, and we email you the link and again when it closes.

What is it?

Reports are public once filed. An agent reads each one first and may propose a fix; a person reviews anything that changes toil.

Report from a terminal

If the CAPTCHA above can't load on your network, send the same report with curl. It needs the commit of the toil you're reporting about, which toil version prints:

toil version --select data.commit

Put the data value it returns in place of <hash>:

curl -sS https://func-toil-feedback.azurewebsites.net/api/report \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"kind":"bug","title":"…","body":"…","email":"you@example.com","commit":"<hash>"}'

Add "version" too if you like. Up to three reports a day from one address.

Have a GitHub account? Open an issue directly.
